name: Runner Extras - TextEncoding::Windows is single-byte
brief: Pins that a stream opened with TextEncoding::Windows writes one byte per representable character, not UTF-8.
description: BC resolves TextEncoding::Windows and ::MSDos to the tenant's default encoding, which on a real service tier is the host's ANSI code page — single-byte. AL that builds a binary format byte by byte (a PDF content stream, a fixed-width export, anything computing its own offsets) depends on one character costing one byte. A runner that answers UTF-8 there silently triples the length of every non-ASCII character and every offset computed from it is wrong.
